# GEO report: acme-mugs **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 24–33/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 21 of 23 points). How it's calculated: low = 5.5 ÷ 23 × 100 = 24. High = (5.5 + 2) ÷ 23 × 100 = 33. Your `robots.txt` tells every crawler to stay out of the whole site. The pages are also built entirely in the browser, so the server's HTML is nearly empty. Both problems are fixable in the code. The one unknown is the canonical URL (the address you declare as the official one for a page). I need your domain to settle it. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Let crawlers in by removing the site-wide block - **Why it matters:** `Disallow: /` asks search crawlers (Googlebot, Bingbot and others) not to read any page, so nothing else on this list can help until it's removed. It also costs the score its cap: with a blocker in place, neither number can go above 40. - **Where:** `public/robots.txt:2` - **What the code says:** `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 50–59/100. This fixes GEO-009 and GEO-014. If the block is deliberate, for example because the site isn't live yet, keep it and tell me. I assumed you want to be found. ### 2. Put the page content in the HTML the server sends - **Why it matters:** Crawlers that don't run JavaScript see an empty page and miss "Handmade ceramic mugs" and the whole catalogue. The catalogue is also fetched in the browser after load. - **Where:** `index.html:8` and `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:6` - **What the code says:** `
` and `fetch('/api/mugs')` - **Size:** Large (add prerendering or server rendering) - **Score after this:** 37–46/100 if applied on its own. ### 3. Give pages a real title, description and language - **Why it matters:** Every page currently shares the generic title "Vite App", has no description, and doesn't declare its language. - **Where:** `index.html:2` and `index.html:5` - **What the code says:** `` and `Vite App` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 33–41/100 if applied on its own. Per-page titles on the client would need item 2 to reach crawlers reliably. ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid and reachable | Clear | `public/robots.txt`, valid lines | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers can access the site | Problem | `public/robots.txt:2` `Disallow: /` (site-wide) | | GEO-014 | Routes are indexable | Problem | `public/robots.txt:2` blocks both routes. No noindex found. | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical URL | Can't tell | No canonical in `index.html`, and no domain declared | | GEO-003 | Content is in server HTML | Problem | `index.html:8` empty root, 2 of 2 routes | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid | Not applicable | No JSON-LD in the repo | | GEO-011 | Sitemap is discoverable | Problem | No sitemap file, no `Sitemap:` line in robots.txt | | GEO-012 | Title, description and html lang | Problem | `index.html:2` has no lang, `index.html:5` is the generic title, no description. Both routes share it. | | GEO-016 | Routes reachable by real links | Problem | `src/main.jsx:11` Catalogue is reached only by a button | | GEO-017 | Snippet restrictions | Clear | No `nosnippet` or `max-snippet` found | | GEO-002 | Accessibility basics | Problem | `src/pages/Home.jsx:5` image has no `alt`. 1 of 2 routes affected. | | GEO-101 | Mobile app association files | Not applicable | No app declared | | GEO-010 | llms.txt (information only) | Not scored | None present | | GEO-102 | App structured data (information only) | Not scored | None present | ## Other problems found - **Catalogue link is a button, not a link:** `src/main.jsx:11`: ``. Use `` so crawlers can follow it. This is also the GEO-016 problem. ## Worth considering - **Describe the hero image:** `src/pages/Home.jsx:5`: ``. Add `alt` text saying what the picture shows, so the content isn't locked inside an image. - **Add a meta description and viewport tag:** `index.html:4`: ``. Add `` and a description that says what the shop sells. - **Give each mug its own page:** `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:11`: `

{m.name}

`. Each mug could have its own address with a name, price and description, which might help it be found and quoted. - **Add Product structured data:** once mugs have their own pages, label each one's price and name with JSON-LD. - **Add details to the home page:** `src/pages/Home.jsx:6`: `Thrown by hand in Bristol and shipped worldwide.` Visitors would likely want shipping costs and times, care instructions and how to order, none of which is on the site as text. - **Say who you are in a machine-readable way:** nothing states the shop's name or links. Organization or WebSite JSON-LD could carry the name and location the page already mentions. - **Show catalogue content as text:** the catalogue shows only mug names. Prices, sizes and materials in the text would make it more useful. - **Link between pages:** the home page doesn't link onward to the catalogue except through the nav button. Add a plain link in the page body. - **Add a 404 route:** `src/main.jsx:20`: the router has two ``s and no catch-all, so unknown addresses render a blank page. ## Can't tell from code - **GEO-015 (canonical):** no canonical tag exists and no site domain is declared. Tell me your domain and I'll treat this as settled. - **GEO-003:** hosting-layer prerendering would change this result. A live check would confirm what crawlers receive. - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. - **Live-only checks:** real status codes, redirects and headers need a live scan. ## Assumptions - You want search engines and AI tools to find this site, so I treated `Disallow: /` as a mistake. - I read all 6 tracked files: `index.html`, `public/robots.txt`, `src/main.jsx`, both pages and `package.json`. That covered the 2 routes, the nav, and the only head and layout. There is no `geo.config.json`, JSON-LD, sitemap or noindex setting. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
